prompt.title: What players report
prompt.description: E.g. "Which colour ball did you pick from the bag?"

options.title: Options
options.description: Between 2 and 12. Each is worth its own points (below 0 takes points off). Tick Colour to give its button that colour.

picks.title: Picks per player
picks.description: How many times each player reports (e.g. 3 draws from the bag). The points of all their picks add up.

showPoints.title: Show the points on the buttons
showPoints.description: Off: players only find out what their pick was worth after reporting it.
